Dear Simen ,
Thank you for reaching
out

Francisco

Main Asset

MP / R1 170001229
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
ObibH9
Problem Description
: DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
Troubleshooting
: I will update the charger to v6.1.3 as per the instructions given. When the charger is free I will proceed. In this version the limit between DC+ and DC- is higher so it might be fixed.
For the site visit we need to measure the following:
Please start measuring from the XD14:7B and 8D to their respective 0V, if the measurement is already different from 1kOhm here, you can replace the cable.
If these points are measuring 1kOhm then we need to move on the next points, after the connector, XD14:7A and 8D, until the StateMonitor.
If the 1kOhm is again not noticed after the XD14, then maybe there is a loose wiring or the connector (very unlikely).
If the 1kOhm is reaching the StateMonitor but we still see this error, please try to swap the EcoG connector with a neighbour one that is not currently being used:
Example
If this still doesn't work please replace the KF13.
It's necessary to make a measurement of the CP to ground of 12V. If we don't have 12V you can replace the cable and take photos of the DC pins for possible dirt or water.
For future reference, your case number is
0415633
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
